verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Soul of my Saviour,
sanctify my breast;
Body of Christ,
be thou my saving guest

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Blood of my Saviour,
bathe me in thy tide,
wash me with water
flowing from thy side.

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Strength and protection
may thy passion be;
O blessed Jesus,
hear and answer me

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Deep in thy wounds, Lord,
hide and shelter me;
so shall I never,
never part from thee.

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
Guard and defend me
from the foe malign;
in death's dread moments
make me only thine

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
call me, and bid me
come to thee on high,
where I may praise thee
with thy saints for aye.
